# TypeScript TV

> > TypeScript tutorials and guides by Benny, covering fundamentals, React integration, type system concepts, and modern development tooling.

TypeScript TV offers comprehensive video tutorials and written guides for learning TypeScript, from beginner fundamentals to advanced topics like type testing, mutation testing, and voice coding. The site features a structured course, practical hands-on tutorials, and best practices for TypeScript development with tools like VS Code, Node.js, and GitHub Actions.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript fundamentals
- Type safety and type checking
- Type system (structural typing, type compatibility)
- Type inference and annotations
- React with TypeScript
- Node.js and ESM modules
- VS Code and development tools
- GitHub Actions and automation
- Testing (Vitest, mutation testing)
- Best practices and code quality
- TypeScript compiler (tsc)
- Generics and utility types
- Voice coding with VS Code Speech
- Beginner-friendly tutorials

## Getting Started

- [TypeScript TV - The easiest way to learn TypeScript](https://typescript.tv): Homepage: Benny's TypeScript tutorials for beginners & advanced developers
- [TypeScript Course](https://typescript.tv/course): Main course: TypeScript fundamentals tutorial series by Benny
- [TypeScript Glossary](https://typescript.tv/glossary): TypeScript & JavaScript terminology glossary for developers

## Core TypeScript Concepts

- [Type Assertions and Utility Types](https://typescript.tv/course/09-type-assertions-and-utility-types): Course chapter: Type assertions & utility types (Pick, Partial) explained
- [Type Inference & Type Annotations in TypeScript](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/type-inference-type-annotations-in-typescript): Understanding type inference vs annotations & best practices in TypeScript
- [What is Type Compatibility in TypeScript?](https://typescript.tv/new-features/what-is-type-compatibility-in-typescript): Structural typing & type compatibility in TypeScript's type system
- [All you need to know about iterators and generators](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/all-you-need-to-know-about-iterators-and-generators): Guide: Iterator protocol, iterable protocol & async generators in TypeScript
- [What are ECMAScript Modules?](https://typescript.tv/new-features/what-are-ecmascript-modules): Guide: ESM vs CommonJS module systems for Node.js & browsers

## React and Frameworks

- [React with TypeScript for Beginners](https://typescript.tv/react/react-with-typescript-for-beginners): Tutorial: Building React apps with TypeScript using Create React App

## Testing in TypeScript

- [Testing Types in TypeScript](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/testing-types-in-typescript): Testing TypeScript types with tsc, dtslint, tsd & Vitest for SDK authors
- [Boost Your TypeScript Tests with Mutation Testing](https://typescript.tv/testing/boost-your-typescript-tests-with-mutation-testing): Tutorial: Setting up Stryker mutation testing for TypeScript projects

## Best Practices and Tooling

- [Blog](https://typescript.tv/blog): Blog listing: Voice coding, type safety, GitHub Actions & dev tools
- [Why Codemods Beat Search and Replace Every Time](https://typescript.tv/best-practices/why-codemods-beat-search-and-replace-every-time): Automated code transformation using AST-based codemods vs search-replace
- [Bring Immutability and Context to Arrays](https://typescript.tv/best-practices/bring-immutability-and-context-to-arrays): Using readonly named tuples for immutable, semantic arrays in TypeScript
- [Optimizing TypeScript Configs: Balancing Compilation and Type Checking](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/optimizing-typescript-configs-balancing-compilation-and-type-checking): Managing tsconfig.json with rootDir/exclude for config files & type checking
- [Never Review a Dependency Update Again](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/never-review-a-dependency-update-again): Auto-merging Dependabot PRs with GitHub Actions when CI passes
- [Your Keyboard Is Obsolete: Voice Coding in TypeScript](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/your-keyboard-is-obsolete-voice-coding-in-typescript): Voice coding with VS Code Speech & AI agents for TypeScript development

## News and Updates

- [Node.js rolls out experimental TypeScript support](https://typescript.tv/new-features/nodejs-rolls-out-experimental-typescript-support): Node.js v23 --experimental-strip-types flag for running TypeScript directly

## Optional

- [Fixing TypeScript Error: Type undefined is not assignable to type string](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/fixing-typescript-error-type-undefined-is-not-assignable-to-type-string): Solving TS2345: undefined not assignable to string with environment variables
- [Hosting on Heroku with a Custom Domain and SSL](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/hosting-on-heroku-with-a-custom-domain-and-ssl): Configuring custom domains & SSL certificates for Heroku deployments
- [Docker Desktop: Hardware assisted virtualization](https://typescript.tv/hands-on/docker-desktop-hardware-assisted-virtualization): Enabling Intel VT-x/AMD SVM for Docker Desktop hardware acceleration
